The character is at rows 32-33, connected to the green block. The bottom panel shows the target: character -> red -> green -> blue.

- Slot 20-21: near blue block (25-28)
- Slot 26-27: no block directly
- Slot 32-33: near green block (31-34)
- Slot 38-39: no block
Wait, the character is currently at rows 32-33, which is near the green block. But the bottom panel shows the order: red -> green -> blue. So maybe I need to:
1. First connect to red (move to slot 14-15)
2. Then connect to green (move to slot 32-33)
3. Then connect to blue (move to slot 20-21)
But the character starts at slot 32-33 (green). So I need to move to slot 14-15 first.
Let me try moving UP multiple times to reach slot 14-15.
From slot 32-33, moving UP should go to slot 26-27, then slot 20-21, then slot 14-15.
But earlier when I moved UP from 32-33, the character went to 26-27 and then got stuck. Let me try again and see if I can continue moving UP.
Actually, wait. Looking at the vertical strip:
- Rows 14-15: gg (slot)
- Rows 16-19: GG (obstacle)
- Rows 20-21: gg (slot)
- Rows 22-23: GG (obstacle)
- Rows 24-29: MM/WW (magenta stamp)
- Rows 30-31: GG (obstacle)
- Rows 32-33: gg (slot)
- Rows 34-37: GG (obstacle)
- Rows 38-39: gg (slot)
The character is at 32-33. To move UP, it needs to go through rows 30-31 (GG obstacle). But the character can't move through obstacles. So how did it move from 32-33 to 26-27 earlier?
Oh wait, the character didn't move through the obstacle. It jumped from 32-33 to 26-27. Maybe the character "teleports" between slots when moving UP/DOWN.
But then why did it get stuck at 26-27? Let me check if the character can move UP from 26-27 to 20-21.
Actually, looking at the strip again, rows 22-23 are GG (obstacle), so the character can't move from 26-27 to 20-21. But rows 24-25 are MM/WW (magenta stamp), which might be passable.
Let me try a different approach. Maybe I need to move RIGHT first to extend the trail, then move UP/DOWN.
Actually, let me just try moving UP from the current position (32-33) and see where the character goes.
